pr_title: hostnamed: expose FirmwareDate as uint64 in dbus
pr_body:
Offer the firmware date as an epoch instead of the literal DMI string.

Closes #25679
pr_comments: Could you also add a brief test for the feature at tests/units/testsuite-71.sh?

> Could you also add a brief test for the feature at tests/units/testsuite-71.sh?

I guess it makes sense to expose it then in hostnamectl? As alternative I can just use `jq` with `hostnamectl --json=short`, but I am not 100% sure if I understand if `test/units/testsiute-71.sh` runs as root in a container. This is required to set a predictable `bios_date` in `/sys/class/dmi/id`.

I noticed the unit tests fail with  `org.freedesktop.hostname1.xml:   24/30 OUTDATED`, so I assume I need to update `man/org.freedesktop.hostname1.xml`.

review_comments: `return -errno` here as timegm() returns the error in that.

timegm() and friends will silently mangle the data in the `struct tm` if not normalized (i.e. "feb 30" is specified or garbage like that). I think we should check for that, i.e. compare if the values we care about still match what we passed in. if we not then the input was apparently garbage, and we should return an error

## Comparison result is always the same

Comparison is always false because r >= 1.

[Show more details](https://github.com/systemd/systemd/security/code-scanning/1628)
Sorry, fixed! Thanks for the review!
